Here, $A$ is a $2\times 1$ matrix and $B$ is a $1\times 2$ matrix. 

There is $1$ column in $A$ and $1$ row in $B,$ so $A$ and $B$ are conformable for multiplication: 

$$
{A}_{2\times \boxed{\text{1}}}{\cdot }_{✓}{B}_{\boxed{\text{1}}\times 2}={AB}_{2\times 2}
$$

Let's compute $AB,$ one element at a time:

$$
\begin{aligned} & [\begin{aligned}5 \\ -2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & -3\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}5 & ∗ \\ ∗ & ∗\end{aligned}], &  & \,5=5\cdot 1 \\  & [\begin{aligned}5 \\ -2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & -3\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}5 & -15 \\ ∗ & ∗\end{aligned}], &  & \,-15=5\cdot (-3) \\  & [\begin{aligned}5 \\ -2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & -3\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}5 & -15 \\ -2 & ∗\end{aligned}], &  & \,-2=-2\cdot 1 \\  & [\begin{aligned}5 \\ -2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & -3\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}5 & -15 \\ -2 & 6\end{aligned}], &  & \,6=-2\cdot (-3)\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, 
$AB=[\begin{aligned}5 & -15 \\ -2 & 6\end{aligned}].$
